_readme: Drop recordings here (.wav .m4a .mp3 .webm .ogg .flac) and run: python scripts/calibrate_fixtures.py
Filename convention infers the verse: <book>_<chapter>_<verse>_<anything>.<ext>, e.g. genesis_1_1_reader1.wav, i_samuel_3_2_dan.m4a
Entries below are OPTIONAL overrides per file: ref, text (pointed), reader, notes, omittedWords (indices the reader skipped), issues (expected Temani deviations per word index), skip.
Missing verse text is fetched from Sefaria (WLC); missing Temani expectations are generated from the frontend (../medaker) and cached in app/fixtures/expected/.

genesis_1_1_reader1.wav.notes: example entry — the file itself is not committed
